newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Kovinotehna first half swings into black.
newsitem.headline: Kovinotehna first half swings into black.

text.p: Slovenia's technical equipment trader Kovinotehna d.d. said on Friday pre-tax profit in the first six months jumped to 37.3 million tolars ($274,600) from a loss of 33.6 million in the year-ago period.
"We managed a profit thanks to cost-cutting, and at the same time we expanded our business," deputy chief executive Milena Sedovnik told Reuters.
Sales climbed to 13.9 billion tolars from 11.9 billion in the first half of 1995. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
